title: Equipment plan renewal
description: Use when the customer's equipment plan is approaching expiration.
allowed_actions: Offer an account and plan review
restrictions: Do not offer a discount unless explicitly authorized by another policy

title: Outstanding balance support
description: Use when payment-related signals are relevant to the customer.
allowed_actions: Ask the customer to verify the outstanding balance
Direct the customer to billing support

title: Service quality review
description: Use when call quality or service-related signals are relevant.
allowed_actions: Direct the customer to technical support
Ask whether the customer has experienced service issues
restrictions: Do not claim that a technical problem exists unless confirmed

title: Low-risk retention
description: Use when predicted churn probability is low.
restrictions: Avoid expensive retention incentives by default
